description: Single storey rear extension (demolition of conservatory)
decision_conditions: <p>The proposed development, by reason of its excessive depth and minimal setback from the side boundaries, would give rise to overshadowing, loss of outlook, and an overbearing visual impact to the detriment of the residential and visual amenities of the occupiers of the neighbouring property No. 15 Lange Road. The proposal would therefore be contrary to the high-quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021 – 2041), and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</p>

<p>The proposed development, by reason of its excessive depth and width, in conjunction with the limited size of the rear garden and the existing rear store and hard-surfaced area, would constitute to an overdevelopment and remove a significant area of private open space and landscaping opportunities from the application site to the residential and visual amenities of the existing and future occupiers of No. 13 Lange Road. The proposal would therefore be contrary to the high-quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021 – 2041), and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).&nbsp;</p>
